value.rationale: A natural one-observable information-theoretic minimax problem has an exact solution for real targets and an optimal universal comparison for complex targets. The theorem quantifies robust recovery beyond qualitative exact-information statements, applies to infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces and arbitrary nonlinear predictors, and the factor-two nonnormal obstruction is dimension-minimal. Not merely a renaming of numerical radius: it identifies the best affine operator approximant from fiber oscillation.
